title: Little Boy in Overalls by Garden Bush, 1949 B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century candid snapshot photo of a young boy standing in a grassy yard beside a lush garden bush and brick steps. He is dressed in light-colored overalls over a long-sleeved shirt, typical of post-WWII children's playwear in late 1940s America. The photograph features characteristic deckle-edged borders and a processing mark dated April 1949 on the reverse side.
